changeFailed.description: Notice when the worker refuses a change; R is its reason.

pLead.message: Dwell records how long each site is in front of you while you are active, and nothing about what you do there. For every hour it keeps one number per site: the domain and the seconds it was in focus. It also counts visits, where a visit starts when you arrive on a site from somewhere else. Page addresses, page titles, search terms and anything you type are never stored.

k4.message: Reels, Shorts and X video redirects per day

k6.message: With the event log on: 24 hours of event times, kinds and domains

pWhere.message: Everything stays in this Chrome profile’s extension storage. It is not synced to your Google account, and it is gone when you remove Dwell or delete all data in Settings.

pNetT.message: No network requests of its own
pNetT.description: Privacy section heading. Must not claim more than the tests check.

pNet.message: Dwell’s own pages and background worker are configured to refuse network requests: the manifest sets the content security policy $CSP$, and the test suite checks it. Its scripts run only on Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and X and send nothing off the device. Its redirects stay within those sites. There is no account, no analytics and no sync.
pNet.description: Privacy paragraph; CSP is the policy shown as code.

pAudit.message: Each claim on this page is auditable in the source code and its test suite.
pAudit.description: Privacy closing line. Say auditable, never provable.

pPermD.message: What Chrome asks you to allow, and why.

perm_storage.message: Keeps your totals and settings in this profile.

perm_tabs.message: Reads the domain of the tab in front, so time goes to the right site.

perm_idle.message: Stops the timer after your idle threshold.

perm_alarms.message: Saves the running total once a minute.

perm_dnr.message: Sends Reels, Shorts and X video viewer addresses to a single-video page, and the Reels feeds home, before the page loads.

perm_hosts.message: Hides Reels and Shorts links, keeps each site’s video viewer to one video, and notices when a video is playing.

catsEmpty.message: Sites appear here once Dwell has recorded them.
catsEmpty.description: Category editor when no site has been recorded yet.
